parsed.explanation: Severity is high: if outed, the traveller faces documented public hostility (70–96% anti-gay polling over two decades), mob killing of a gender-nonconforming teenager left unsolved, corrective rape, and police who leak, fail to investigate and decline to protect — state-tolerated targeting with effectively no recourse (tiers 2–3). Detention adds identity-targeted prisoner violence with no gender-recognition framework for accommodation. The buggery statute is secondary but signals the climate. Countervailing: no trans-specific presentation offence, no documented border/visitor universal-exposure measure, entry decisions have cut against anti-gay actors, and resort areas are insulated bubbles — so no tier-1 state-imposed rule. Recent violence evidence (2023 lockup video, 2023 survey) keeps this current rather than merely historical. Net: documented societal hostility plus official impunity without an organised state campaign places it in High Risk.
